# Moses Yebei - repository estate

> 1407 public repositories, each analysed by a deterministic pipeline:
> file census, architecture pass, dependency and advisory scan, hygiene audit,
> and an eight-category grade. No language model produces any figure on this
> site - every number is measured from a tree, a history or a manifest, and the
> same inputs give the same output. Repositories that have not been analysed are
> marked as such rather than being reported as clean.

## Data

- [Schema](https://moses-y.github.io/data/schema.json): what every field in the index means. Read this first; the record keys are single letters.
- [Index](https://moses-y.github.io/data/index.json): all 1407 repositories with language, domain, kind, capabilities, hygiene severities and semantic coordinates, plus 3444 similarity edges. Large - prefer the neighbourhood files below for traversal.
- [Relations manifest](https://moses-y.github.io/data/relations.json): edge types, thresholds and counts for the relation layer.
- [Clusters](https://moses-y.github.io/data/clusters.json): 59 groups of near-duplicate work covering 167 repositories, each with member grades and which one is the keeper.
- [Neighbourhood](https://moses-y.github.io/data/kin/1004131322.json): one file per repository id, about 1 KB each: nearest semantic kin and repositories sharing its dependency stack, with the shared packages named. Fetch https://moses-y.github.io/data/kin/<id>.json to walk from one repository to its neighbours without loading the index.
- [Grades](https://moses-y.github.io/data/grades.json): 910 graded repositories, mean 61.3, with the per-category score, weight and the findings charged against each.
- [Hygiene](https://moses-y.github.io/data/hygiene.json): the raw audit findings behind the grades.
- [Dependencies](https://moses-y.github.io/data/deps.json): declared dependencies per repository by ecosystem.
- [Search](https://moses-y.github.io/data/search.json): inverted index, token to position in the index records.

## Pages

- [Projects](https://moses-y.github.io/projects.html): every repository with its measured facts.
- [Code Graph](https://moses-y.github.io/knowledge-graph.html): the semantic map, similarity edges drawn.
- [Code Brain](https://moses-y.github.io/code-brain.html): domains to languages to repositories to modules.
- [Briefings](https://moses-y.github.io/blog/): a written analysis per repository at /blog/<name>.html.
- [Site map](https://moses-y.github.io/sitemap.html): everything, grouped by domain.

## Notes

- Domains: Web & Interfaces 494, AI & Data 474, Systems & Infra 278, Knowledge & Content 62, Agent Skills & Plugins 49, Mobile 48, Other 2.
- Two edge types relate repositories. "semantic" is cosine similarity of the repository embedding and answers "solves the same problem". "stack" is IDF-weighted overlap of declared dependencies and answers "built the way you build things". A pair scoring on both is the strongest signal that one repository is a usable starting point for the other.
- Stack edges exist only for the 324 repositories that declare dependencies in a manifest this pipeline reads.
- Grades cover 910 of 1407 repositories. An absent grade means not yet audited, not a bad grade.
- Generated 2026-08-25.
